what_it_is: Known asteroids, measured where IMCCE SkyBoT says they were, with no search. Adding the images along each path is compared with single images, and with control paths 60" away. It measures how much deeper stacking reaches. It discovers nothing.
examples_rule: stacked S/N 5 or more, every single photo under S/N 4, 8 or more photos, faintest first (re-picked after the lock)
